PLAN
- Stage 0 (instrumentation lock, no behavior change): freeze current production config as `v_baseline`; snapshot all logged axes (cross_model_std, model_run_age, ou_z, cloud_cover, wind, settle_hour, KLGA obs, HRRR bias-corrected, p_yes, quote, settle) into a versioned feature store with schema + timestamps; add run-id tagging so every downstream artifact is reproducible and every later stage is a flag-gated diff vs baseline.
- Stage 1 (walk-forward harness): build an offline replay/backtester over the feature store with strictly expanding-window walk-forward (no lookahead: features must be computable at quote time); report per-slice P&L, Brier/log-loss, calibration curves, and Wilson CIs. Gate: harness must reproduce live paper P&L (~-31c/contract, n=430) within Wilson overlap before any model work proceeds.
- Stage 2 (signal mining on logged axes, offline only): univariate + pairwise screening of cross_model_std, model_run_age, ou_z, cloud, wind, and interactions (settle_hour × ou_z, settle_hour × cross_model_std, wind × ou_z) against residual (outcome − p_yes); rank by walk-forward IC with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q≤0.10 and min slice n≥60; shortlist max 5 candidate signals. No production change.
- Stage 3 (p_yes v2 candidate, SHADOW): train a challenger forecaster — logistic/GBM with monotone constraints on ou_z and cross_model_std, isotonic-calibrated — that consumes Stage 2 shortlist + existing KLGA/HRRR blend; emit `p_yes_v2` alongside production `p_yes` in SHADOW (log-only, zero influence on sizing/gating). Require walk-forward Brier improvement ≥2% and calibration-in-the-large |intercept|≤0.05 vs baseline.
- Stage 4 (flow layer promotion path): flow layer stays SHADOW but is scored as if live (hypothetical fills, fees, slippage); define promotion ladder SHADOW → MICRO (size cap 1 unit, 5% of bankroll at risk) → ARMED; each rung requires Wilson lower bound on edge > +2c/contract, BH-FDR q≤0.10 across the active-slice family, n≥200 shadow decisions, and max drawdown in shadow ≤ 2× baseline.
- Stage 5 (tree retrain, gated): retrain adaptive tree on enriched feature set (shortlist + settle_hour) with min-leaf n≥40, max depth 3, nested walk-forward split-pruning; existing 2 armed settle_hour slices remain untouched; new slices may only ARM via the existing Wilson+FDR+sample gates at MICRO size first.
- Stage 6 (licensing ledger): persist a `signal_license` table (signal id, stage, gate results, n, Wilson bound, FDR q, armed size, rollback flag); every armed change is one-flag reversible to `v_baseline` within one deploy; weekly auto-demote any slice whose trailing 100-decision Wilson bound falls below 0.

RISKS
- Multiple-comparisons overfitting during Stage 2 mining → mitigated by BH-FDR + strict walk-forward, but residual risk of selection bias remains; cap shortlist at 5 and log all tested hypotheses (including failures) to keep FDR denominator honest.
- Lookahead leakage via model_run_age / settle-time features (data stamped post-quote) → enforce quote-time availability check in harness; treat any feature failing the check as disqualified.
- Thin-slice false edge: current armed settle_hour slices are ~5c on thin n; enriched features may fragment slices further → min-leaf n≥40 and MICRO-first sizing limit blast radius.
- p_yes_v2 degradation under regime shift (model run changes, NWS source drift) → shadow period must span ≥2 distinct weather regimes before promotion.
- Calibration improvement without economic edge (better Brier, worse P&L after fees) → promotion requires P&L-based gates, not accuracy metrics alone.
- Gate erosion under pressure to show progress (P&L -31c/contract creates urgency) → DECISION_RULES hard-code non-overridable gates.
- Correlated candidates (ou_z and cross_model_std may be collinear) → drop candidates with |ρ|>0.7 vs an already-shortlisted signal.

CHECKPOINTS
- CP1 (end Stage 1): harness reproduces live baseline within Wilson CI; block Stage 2 until true.
- CP2 (end Stage 2): shortlist of ≤5 signals with q≤0.10, n≥60, signed walk-forward IC; if zero signals pass, go to IF_FAIL path A.
- CP3 (Stage 3, ≥4 weeks shadow, ≥2 regimes): p_yes_v2 Brier ≥2% better, calibration acceptable, shadow P&L Wilson bound > 0; else stay SHADOW or revert.
- CP4 (Stage 4): flow layer completes 200 shadow decisions with positive Wilson bound; promote to MICRO only, never directly to ARMED.
- CP5 (Stage 5): any new tree slice clears existing Wilson+FDR+sample gates at MICRO for ≥100 decisions before ARMED sizing.
- CP6 (ongoing, weekly): license ledger audit — any slice failing trailing gates auto-demoted one rung; two consecutive demotions → full revert to SHADOW.

IF_FAIL
- Path A (Stage 2 yields zero licensed signals): conclude logged axes carry no incremental edge at current n; pivot to (a) extending observation window 2× before re-mining, (b) adding one new orthogonal data axis (e.g., top-of-book depth / quote staleness) in SHADOW, (c) freezing all learning changes and letting current armed slices accumulate n under existing gates.
- Path B (p_yes_v2 wins on Brier but loses on P&L): keep v2 SHADOW permanently; investigate edge concentration — restrict v2 influence to slices where its shadow P&L Wilson bound > +2c, blend weight capped at 0.3.
- Path C (any promoted change degrades live: trailing-100 Wilson bound < 0): one-flag revert to `v_baseline` for that component only; post-mortem logged to ledger; re-promotion requires full ladder re-climb with n reset to 0.
- Path D (harness cannot reproduce baseline at CP1): halt all model work; fix data/logging pipeline first — no learning changes on an unvalidated harness.

DECISION_RULES
- No signal, slice, or p_yes version influences sizing or gating until it has passed SHADOW → MICRO → ARMED with the existing Wilson+FDR+sample gates applied unchanged at each
